general.autoStartHint: Start Lenz quietly when you log in
general.checkUpdateHint: Check on launch and every 24 hours using GitHub Releases
general.openOnLaunchHint: When off, stays in the menu bar only
general.selectionIndicatorHint: Float a small icon at the cursor after selecting text; click to translate (needs Accessibility permission)
general.accessibilityRequired: The selection indicator needs Accessibility access. Refresh after granting it.
general.screenRecordingRequired: Screenshots and overlays need Screen Recording access.
general.selectionIndicatorWindowsHint: Float an icon at the cursor after selecting text; click to translate

shortcuts.selectionHint: Translate the text selected at the cursor
shortcuts.screenshotHint: Select a region, OCR, then show the translation
shortcuts.overlayHint: Render the translation right over the original pixels
shortcuts.recordingHint: Press the new shortcut; Backspace clears it and Esc cancels.
shortcuts.modifierRequired: Letter and number shortcuts need at least one modifier.
shortcuts.duplicate: This shortcut is already used by “{{name}}”.
shortcuts.permissionNote: Word translation needs macOS Accessibility permission; overlay needs Screen Recording. Both are requested on first use.
shortcuts.permissionWindows: Selection detection uses Windows UI Automation. OCR requires installed system language packs.

engines.desc: Stack multiple engines and set a default. Local models keep every request on-device.
engines.emptyDesc: Add a local engine like LM Studio or Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible / cloud service.
engines.name: Name
engines.appleNote: Apple system translation is a placeholder — native bridge not wired yet, cannot test.
engines.maxTokensHint: Cap tokens in the response; blank = unlimited
engines.appleUnavailable: Apple Translation requires macOS 15 or later. Use OpenAI-compatible or cloud engines on this platform.
engines.appleReady: Uses on-device Apple Translation. The first request may show the system language download dialog; increase the timeout while installing languages.
engines.timeoutHint: 1000–600000 ms. Allow more time when installing Apple translation languages for the first time.

ocr.accuracyHint: “Accurate” is ~2× slower but handles small text
ocr.languagesDesc: Add or remove languages, then drag or use the arrows to change their priority.
ocr.backendWindowsHint: Windows system OCR requires the matching recognition language packs
ocr.systemAccuracy: Recognition strategy is managed by Windows OCR
ocr.systemConfidence: Windows OCR does not provide per-line confidence
ocr.systemFallback: Use system languages when preferred languages are unavailable
ocr.invalidLanguage: Enter a valid language tag, such as en-US, zh-Hans, or ja-JP.
ocr.windowsLanguages: Install recognition language packs in System Settings. Preferred languages are tried in order.
ocr.languageMissing: No installed OCR language packs were found.
ocr.languageRequired: Choose at least one installed language when system fallback is disabled.
ocr.autoDetectRequires13: Automatic language detection requires macOS 13 or later. This system uses the preferred recognition languages.
ocr.packageRequired: Install the Windows MSIX version and open Lenz from the Start menu to use system OCR.

about.privacy: OCR and Apple Translation run locally. Cloud translation requests go only to your configured provider. Lenz collects no analytics and requires no account.
about.noRelease: No accessible public release is available yet

overlay.title: Overlay translation
overlay.closeFailed: Could not close. Please try the close button again.
overlay.failed: Processing failed. Close and select the area again, or check your translation service settings.

error.noText: No text found. Try selecting again.
error.captureTimeout: Screen capture timed out. Check screen recording permission and try again.
error.ocrTimeout: Text recognition timed out. Select a smaller area or try again later.
error.package_required: Install the Windows MSIX version and open Lenz from the Start menu to use system OCR.
